name: radio
description: A native radio input. Group inputs by sharing a name and pair them with Label.

files.content:
---
/**
 * OpenUI Radio — framework-native, zero runtime dependencies.
 *
 * Plain JavaScript frontmatter (no `lang="ts"`) so the same source installs
 * into TypeScript and JavaScript Astro projects. Types live in JSDoc.
 *
 * @typedef {Object} RadioProps
 * @property {boolean} [invalid]
 * @property {string} [class]
 */

const { invalid = false, class: className = "", ...rest } = Astro.props;

const BASE_CLASSES =
  "size-4 shrink-0 cursor-pointer accent-zinc-900 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:accent-zinc-50 dark:focus-visible:ring-zinc-600 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-950";

const classes = [
  BASE_CLASSES,
  invalid ? "outline outline-1 outline-red-500 dark:outline-red-400" : "",
  className,
]
  .filter(Boolean)
  .join(" ");
---

<input type="radio" data-invalid={invalid || undefined} class={classes} {...rest} />
